2. "Energy ladder, gaps and ratios rechecked":
"Recomputed ladder: P2 15 < P3 24 < P1 44 < P4 64 kWh. Margins over the P2 minimum: P3 +9, P1 +29, P4 +49 kWh. Consecutive gaps: 24−15 = 9, 44−24 = 20, 64−44 = 20.
